detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

BPC-157 / TB-500 (Tβ4)

Chemical Information: BPC-157
  • Chemical Name: Body Protection Compound-157 (BPC-157)
  • Molecular Formula: C62H98N16O22
  • Molecular Weight: 1419.5 g/mol
  • Sequence: Gly-Glu-Pro-Pro-Pro-Gly-Lys-Pro-Ala-Asp-Val-Asp-Asp-Phe
Chemical Information: TB-500(Tβ4)
  • Chemical Name: TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4)
  • Molecular Formula: C212H350N56O78S
  • Molecular Weight: 4963.5 g/mol
  • Sequence: Ac-Ser-Asp-Lys-Pro-Asp-Met-Ala-Glu-Ile-Glu-Lys-Phe-Asp-Lys-Ser-Lys-Leu-Lys-Lys-Thr-Glu-Thr-Gln-Glu-Lys-Asn-Pro-Leu-Pro-Ser-Lys-Glu-Thr-Ile-Glu-Gln-Glu-Lys-Gln-Ala-Gly-Glu-Ser
Produc Description:

BPC-157 / TB-500 (Tβ4) is a combined peptide formulation consisting of two synthetic peptides commonly studied in laboratory research environments. BPC-157 is a penta-decapeptide consisting of a defined amino acid sequence, while TB-500 (Tβ4) is a synthetic peptide corresponding to Thymosin Beta-4. This product is supplied as a pre-formulated aqueous research solution, designed to support controlled experimental workflows where multi-peptide systems are evaluated under standardized laboratory conditions.

Research Applications:
  • Investigation of multi-peptide behavior in controlled in vitro systems
  • Study of peptide stability and compatibility in aqueous formulations
  • Evaluation of peptide interactions in comparative laboratory models
  • Research involving combined regulatory peptide systems
Storage and Handling:
  • Store refrigerated at 2–8 °C
  • Do not freeze
  • Protect from light
  • Handle using aseptic laboratory techniques
Product Specifications:
  • Formulation: Aqueous solution
  • Concentration: 1 mg/mL (each peptide)
  • Total Content: 30 mg BPC-157 / 30 mg TB-500 per bottle
  • Volume: 30 mL
  • Delivery Format: Metered liquid solution
  • Dispenses per Container: ~200
  • Amount per Dispense: ~150 mcg of each compound
Compliance Notice:

BPC-157 / TB-500 is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
